catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class binds an oscilloscope's automatic setup: cap.device.configure.v1 is a named-parameter write and there is no autoscale class. The action sends the clone's :AUToset on and returns the channel-1 scale and coupling read back from the metadata.
No catalogue class starts continuous acquisition on an instrument: cap.process.run.v1 is a process recipe and cap.device.self_test.v1 is a self-test. The action sends the clone's :run.
No catalogue class stops an oscilloscope acquisition: cap.motion.stop.v1 is motion-specific. The action sends the clone's :stop and is the driver's safe-state action.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/kletternaut__scopemcp --backend fake (exit 0); the digest is the line the check printed and the evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names the PythonObjectDriver helper, but the upstream builds every command from parts (a 4-byte little-endian length header, a colon-prefixed SCPI line and a line feed) and the channel command embeds the channel number, so this package is a direct Driver over ds1102_mcp:ScopeController with native.py. The card floor is R0; the driver resolves to R1 because cap.device.configure.v1 is R1. Covered: the metadata reads (model, run status, channel 1 and 2 frequency, scale, coupling and raw offset) and the writes (channel 1 scale, coupling and offset, horizontal scale, trigger mode, slope, source and level), the autoset, run and safe-state stop actions, and the native e-stop. The vertical scale, horizontal scale, offset and trigger level are operator_required; site-limits.example.json is an example overlay, and the coupling and trigger allowed sets cite ds1102_mcp.py. NOT COVERED: the waveform array from :DATA:WAVE:SCREEN:CH1?/CH2? (1520 signed 16-bit samples per channel, 3040 bytes plus a 4-byte header) and its voltage conversion, channel-2 settings, the screenshot/frame buffer and the USB reconnect logic; the standard has no trace-array transport. The fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording; every value in it is a placeholder, and the upstream class has no simulator. No hardware was attached and the hardware backend was never run. This package is model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run wC-029) and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null, no human reviewed or tested it, and no hardware run is claimed. The loader's reviewed_by refusal applies only at R2 and R3, so this R1 package does not claim that protection. The firmware RUNSTATUS field always reports TRIG even when stopped (README.md:95), so the run/stop actions report their receipts and commands rather than a state change. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
